-2-

about half an hour later they left together with my father.
The above is a true statement.
Addendum:
    About two months ago, my father scolded me as a useless
boy. He stated that some boy at the age of 14 had already
served as an orderly in the Chinese Army, why a boy like me,
15 years old, had no ambition to render services in the Mobile
Units.
    I did not see my father give anything to the two accused
on any occasion.
    This is my true statement.

                                Signed.
pages.zh:
-2-

大约半小时后，他们与我父亲一起离开。
以上陈述属实。
附录：
    大约两个月前，我父亲骂我是个没用的孩子。他说有些14岁的男孩已经在国军中担任勤务兵，为什么像我这样15岁的男孩却没有志向去机动队服役。
    我从未在任何场合看到我父亲给过两名被告任何东西。
    这是我的真实陈述。

                                签名。

pages.en:
Statement of 2nd accused.

Koo Kyung Yoong
Pootung                                C.D.S.115
Central Station    30-4-1938      translated       Clerk F.C. Fan
                                      xxxxxx

Koo Kyung Yoong, aged 18 years, native of Pootung, S/Un-employed, residing at No.167 Route Destelan, French Concession.

I made the acquaintance of Ts Voh Ming for about one year when we were playing football, and I used to visit his home for amusement. On the 26-4-38 I visited Ts Voh Ming's home at No. 155 Route Prosper Paris, where we conversed regarding the traitorous and patriotic affairs. At the time of leaving the place I was invited by Ts Voh Ming to call on him very often. When I visited Ts Voh Ming's home on the 27-4-38 I was informed by him regarding a leading traitor, name unknown, who is the managing director of the Commercial Bank of China, The Bund. This man was solely responsible for supplying a staggering figure of $500,000.00 to the Japanese when the made-in-Japan "Reformed Government of the Republic of China" was established in Nanking. Ts Voh Ming further stated that such a traitor should be exterminated, but in the course of insufficient strength he invited me to assist in killing the said banker. I agreed to do so. I was then warned by Ts Voh Ming to keep the secret and he would accompany me to the scene to point out the intended victim. In case of my arrest I could only say that I was sent by the Pootung Mobile Unit and he would try to get my release.

On the 29-4-38 I met Ts Voh Ming and his friend named Chu Sih Kwei at the former's home. Chu Sih Kwei (absconded) voluntarily declared to join the participation with us. Chu Sih Kwei and myself were then informed by Ts Voh Ming to call on him before 7 o'clock the following day.

At about 6.45 a.m. I, accompanied by Chu Sih Kwei (not
pages.zh:
第二被告供词。

顾景荣 (Koo Kyung Yoong)
浦东                                C.D.S.115
中央巡捕房    1938年4月30日      翻译       书记员 F.C. Fan
                                      xxxxxx

顾景荣，18岁，浦东人，职业：无业，住址：法租界德斯特兰路（Route Destelan）167号。

我因踢足球结识了朱沃明 (Ts Voh Ming)，相识约一年，常去他家消遣。1938年4月26日，我前往朱沃明位于法租界普罗斯佩巴黎路（Route Prosper Paris）155号的家中，我们就汉奸与爱国事务进行了交谈。离开时，朱沃明邀请我经常去拜访他。1938年4月27日，我再次造访朱沃明家时，他告知我有一名主要汉奸，姓名不详，系外滩中国银行总经理。此人独自负责向日本方面提供高达500,000.00美元的巨款，用于在南京成立伪“中华民国维新政府”。朱沃明进一步表示，此类汉奸应予铲除，但因力量不足，他邀请我协助刺杀该银行家。我同意了。随后朱沃明警告我要保守秘密，并称他会陪同我前往现场指认预定受害者。万一我被捕，我只能说是由浦东流动队派来的，他会设法使我获释。

1938年4月29日，我在朱沃明家中遇见了他及其名为朱士贵 (Chu Sih Kwei) 的朋友。朱士贵（在逃）自愿声明加入我们的行动。随后朱沃明通知朱士贵和我于次日7点前去找他。

上午6点45分左右，我偕同朱士贵（未

pages.en:
-2-

arrested), went to Ts's home and met a stranger(i.e. Ts Zung Tson
arrested) there. Ts Voh Ming gave one hand-grenade to me and the
other to Ts Zung Tsoong,(which he took from off the top of a
wardrobe), at the same time teaching me how to use it. He also
showed me and 1st accused a photograph of a very stout man, with
a large wide mouth which he said was the man he wanted killed.

At about 8 a.m. we arrived at The Bund by tramcar. I kept
observation at the North side in front of the Commercial Bank of
China while Ts Zung Tsoong kept standing at the South side of
the said bank. Ts Voh Ming and Chu,Sih Kwei walked to and fro
outside the main entrance of the bank.

At about 10.10 a.m. same date, one man who came out from the
above bank and boarded a private ricsha proceeding in a Northerly
direction along The Bund, was pointed out to me by Ts Voh Ming as
the managing director of the bank. I was instructed by Ts Voh
Ming to make pursuit, which I did. Upon arriving at The Bund
near Foochow Road I threw my hand-grenade onto the ricsha and
immediately turned about running toward South along The Bund,
but after I ran a few steps I was apprehended by the Police.

I am not a member of the Mobile Unit, but was promised that
if this "case" was successful I would be enrolled as a member of
the Mobile Unit and would receive $30.00 per month. This was
promised me by Ts Voh Ming(not arrested). I have had no connect-
ion with any other terroristic activities, whatever.

This is my true statement.

Signed.
pages.zh:
-2-

被捕）前往朱家，在那里遇到一名陌生人（即已被捕的朱宗松 (Ts Zung Tson)）。朱沃明从衣柜顶上取下一枚手榴弹给我，另一枚给了朱宗松，同时教我如何使用。他还给我和第一被告看了一张照片，照片中是一个体型非常肥胖、嘴巴宽大的男子，他说这就是他要杀掉的人。

上午8点左右，我们乘电车到达外滩。我在中国银行北侧进行观察，而朱宗松则站在该银行南侧。朱沃明和朱士贵在银行正门外来回走动。

同日约上午10点10分，一名男子从上述银行出来，登上一辆沿外滩向北行驶的私人黄包车，朱沃明向我指出此人即为该银行总经理。朱沃明指令我进行追击，我便照办。追至外滩近福州路处，我将手榴弹扔向黄包车，随即转身沿外滩向南奔跑，但跑了数步后便被警察逮捕。

我并非流动队成员，但朱沃明（未被捕）曾许诺，如果此“案子”成功，我将被吸纳为流动队成员，并每月领取30.00美元薪水。我与任何其他恐怖活动均无关联。

以上是我的真实供词。

签名。

pages.en:
Statement of the 1st accused.

Ts Zung Tsoong
Quinsan                                      C.D.S.115
Central Station      30-4-1938       translated
                                     xxxxxxxx   Clerk F.C. Fan

Ts Zung Tsoong, aged 23 years, native of Quinsan, S/Unemploy-
ed, residing in a Rubber Shoe Factory, No.7 Avenue Haig, F.C..
    On the 20-8-37, I joined the guerrille corp of the Chinese
troops at Tseu Kya Jau in company with several others in the
Western district of Shanghai and I was transferred to a station
at Nan Wei, Footung, in October of the same year.
    On 26-4-38, I asked leave for one week and came to Shanghai.
I took my abode with a friend named Kyung Tsong who is a worker
employed by the above mentioned Rubber Shoe Factory during night,
and I used to spend my day time in Ts Voh Ming's home at No.155
Route Prosper Paris, French Concession.
    On the evening of 28-4-38, I was told by Ts Voh Ming regard-
ing a leading traitor, name unknown, who is the managing director
of the Commercial Bank of China. This banker, Ts Voh Ming further
stated, should be exterminated on the ground that he afforded
influencial effort and support to the newly established "Reformed
Government of the Republic of China" in Nanking. Ts stated that
he himself would adopt the most drastic measures against the
banker but on my presence in his home, he stated it was best for
me to assist him in killing the banker with hand-grenade. He
expressed his willingness to accompany me to the scene for the
purpose of recognising the intended victim. Ts stated if this
plan was successfully carried out it would mean a great task
served for the country. I was warned to keep the affair secret.
I agreed.
    On the 29-4-38 when I called Ts Voh Ming at his home I was
told to call him in the early morning the following day.
pages.zh:
第一被告供词。

朱宗松 (Ts Zung Tsoong)
昆山                                      C.D.S.115
中央巡捕房      1938年4月30日       翻译
                                     xxxxxxxx   书记员 F.C. Fan

朱宗松，23岁，昆山人，职业：无业，住址：法租界海格路（Avenue Haig）7号某橡胶鞋厂内。
    1937年8月20日，我与上海西区的其他几人一同加入了位于曹家渡的中国军队游击队，同年10月被调往浦东南汇的一个驻地。
    1938年4月26日，我请假一周来到上海。我借宿在一位名叫京宗 (Kyung Tsong) 的朋友处，他是上述橡胶鞋厂的夜班工人，白天我通常在朱沃明位于法租界普罗斯佩巴黎路155号的家中度过。
    1938年4月28日晚，朱沃明告诉我有一名主要汉奸，姓名不详，系中国银行总经理。朱沃明进一步指出，鉴于该银行家为南京新成立的伪“中华民国维新政府”提供了有力的努力和支持，应当将其铲除。朱表示他将亲自对该银行家采取最严厉的措施，但既然我在他家，他认为最好由我协助他用手榴弹刺杀该银行家。他表示愿意陪同我前往现场以识别预定受害者。朱称如果此计划成功实施，意味着为国家立了一大功。他警告我要对此事保密。我同意了。
    1938年4月29日，当我去朱沃明家找他时，他让我第二天清晨去找他。

pages.en:
-2-

At about 6 a.m. the following day(30-4-38) I went to Ts Voh
Ming's home where after waiting half-an-hour later, I met Koo
Kyung Yoong(arrested) and the other man(absconded, name unknown).
Later Ts Voh Ming gave one hand-grenade to me and the other to
Koo Kyung Yoong, which he took from the top of a wardrobe, wrapp-
ed in newspapers.

At about 8 a.m. to-day(30-4-38) we, 4 in number, proceeded
to The Bund by tramcar and upon arriving at the main entrance of
the Commercial Bank of China, I kept watch at the South side
while Koo Kyung Yoong kept observation at the North side of the
said bank. Ts Voh Ming and the absconded man(wearing blue cotton
jacket and pants) walked to and fro in front of the bank.

At about 10 a.m. same date, one man who came out from the
bank and boarded a private ricksha proceeding in a Northerly
direction along The Bund, was pointed out to me by Ts Voh Ming
as the managing director of the bank. Upon instructions being
given by Ts Voh Ming, I made pursuit with a hand-grenade in my
hand. I threw the hand-grenade at the intended victim on The
Bund near Foochow Road and then turned about, running South along
The Bund, but I was apprehended by Police on The Bund opposite
the Commercial Bank of China.

At "Nan-wei" about 5,000 men are enrolled as guerrillas
with a pay of $6.00 per month - rice money.

The unit(Mobile) to which I was attached was known as the
"Hwa-nan Mobile Unit". There is about 40,000 guerrillas operat-
ing at Shanghai(Western country-side) and Footung. I was told
that from our superior officers to move slowly towards the
pages.zh:
-2-

次日（1938年4月30日）上午6点左右，我前往朱沃明家，等待半小时后，见到了顾景荣（已被捕）和另一名男子（在逃，姓名不详）。随后，朱沃明从衣柜顶上取下用报纸包裹的手榴弹，一枚给了我，另一枚给了顾景荣。

今日（1938年4月30日）上午8点左右，我们四人乘电车前往外滩，抵达中国银行正门后，我在该银行南侧监视，而顾景荣在该银行北侧进行观察。朱沃明和那名在逃男子（身穿蓝色棉布夹克和裤子）在银行门前来回走动。

同日约上午10点，一名男子从银行出来，登上一辆沿外滩向北行驶的私人黄包车，朱沃明向我指出此人即为该银行总经理。接到朱沃明的指令后，我手持手榴弹进行追击。在外滩近福州路处，我向预定受害者投掷了手榴弹，随即转身沿外滩向南奔跑，但在外滩中国银行对面被警察逮捕。

在“南汇”约有5,000人被编入游击队，月薪6.00美元——作为米贴。

我所属的单位（流动队）称为“华南流动队”。在上海（西部乡村）和浦东约有40,000名游击队员在活动。据上级军官告知，我们要缓慢向

pages.en:
-3-

"Taiho" lake region in order to support our advancing soldiers.
Ts Voh Ming told me he was attached to the "Central Mobile
Unit" which was operating in the French Concession and the
surrounding Chinese countryside. I do not know any other members
of the "Central Special Mobile Unit", as my work always kept me
in Footung where I was mainly employed as a spy, locating Japanese
Military positions, strength, etc., and re-laying same to my No.1
Divisional Commander named Zung Doo, at Nan-wei. As I was in
Shanghai on 1 week's special leave, which was granted by Zung Doo,
I visited my friend Ts Voh Ming, who then asked me to assist him
to assassinate the managing director of the Commercial Bank of
China. He did not tell me the name of the intended victim, but
said that he would point him out to me and the 2nd accused. Ts
Voh Ming and Chu Sih Kwei (both not arrested) acted as "spotters",
whilst I and the 2nd accused carried the hand-grenades.
I have not participated in any other terroristic activities
in the International Settlement or the French Concession.
The book found in my possession containing Chinese and
Japanese characters (translation from Chinese into Japanese) was
used for the purpose of enabling me to move freely in Japanese
controlled territory.
This is my true statement.
Signed.
pages.zh:
-3-

“太湖”地区移动，以支援我军推进部队。朱沃明告诉我，他隶属于在法租界及周边中国乡村活动的“中央流动队”。我不认识“中央特别流动队”的其他成员，因为我的工作一直使我在浦东，主要担任间谍，侦察日军阵地、兵力等，并将情报转报给在南汇的第一师指挥官钟杜 (Zung Doo)。由于我持有钟杜批准的一周特别假期在上海，我去拜访了朋友朱沃明，他随即请求我协助刺杀中国银行总经理。他没有告诉我预定受害者的姓名，但说他会指给我和第二被告看。朱沃明和朱士贵（两人均未被捕）充当“望风者”，而我和第二被告携带手榴弹。
我未曾参与公共租界或法租界内的任何其他恐怖活动。
在我身上发现的那本包含中日文字符（中译日）的书，是为了使我能在日军控制区内自由行动而使用的。
以上是我的真实供词。
签名。

pages.en:
Tsang Hung Fah, age 24, native of Kompo,
residing in loctung.

Central             30/4/38           translated
                                    ////      Clerk Sung.

At about 10.10a.m. on the 30/4/38 I was proceeding along
Foochow Rd. The Bund S.to N.when I heard an explosion,which I
did not pay attention to. Immediately afterwards I heard a further
explosion which was followed by an injury to my chest. As my
chest was bleeding a policeman sent me to the station,from where
I was conveyed to the Lester Hospital for treatment.
I did not see the bombs thrown.

                                Cross signed.
pages.zh:
曾洪发 (Tsang Hung Fah)，24岁，高邮人，
住洛东。

中央             1938年4月30日           翻译
                                    ////      书记员 Sung。

1938年4月30日上午10点10分左右，我正沿福州路外滩段由南向北行走，此时听到一声爆炸，我并未在意。紧接着又听到一声爆炸，随后我的胸部受伤。由于胸部流血，一名警察将我送往巡捕房，随后我被转送至雷士德医院（Lester Hospital）接受治疗。
我没有看到炸弹被投掷。

                                交叉签名。

pages.en:
Sung Kwong Yoong, age 49, native of Shantung,
C.P.W. 166.

Central 30/4/38 translated Clerk Sung
/////

At about 9.30a.m. on the 30/4/38 I proceeded to The Bund
to see my friend and at about 10.10a.m. same date I arrived at
Foochow Rd. bund when I heard an explosion. My right foot was
hurt and I heard a further explosion. I immediately hired a
public ricksha and proceeded to the Lester Hospital for treatment.
Afterwards I was accompanied to the station by a policeman.
I have no knowledge of the occurrence and I did not see the
bombs thrown.

Signed.
pages.zh:
宋光荣 (Sung Kwong Yoong)，49岁，山东人，
C.P.W. 166。

中央 1938年4月30日 翻译 书记员 Sung
/////

1938年4月30日上午9点30分左右，我前往外滩看望朋友，同日约上午10点10分，我到达福州路外滩处时听到一声爆炸。我的右脚受伤，随后又听到一声爆炸。我立即雇了一辆公共黄包车前往雷士德医院接受治疗。之后，一名警察陪我前往巡捕房。
我对事发经过一无所知，也没有看到炸弹被投掷。

签名。

pages.en:
Zung Ching Foh, age 53, native of Haimen,
residing at House No.3 Lane No.401 Gordon Rd. and employed
as a mafoo therein.

Central          30/4/38          ////           Clerk Sung
                                translated

At about 10a.m. on the 30/4/38 I left my pony carriage on
Soochow Rd. near The Bund and about 10 minutes resulted from a
burst m/car tyre. Immediately afterwards I heard a further
explosion and discovered my horse is injured. My left arm was
also slightly wounded. I was then instructed by my foreign
master to visit the Lester Hospital. On return from the hospital
I sent my horse to a doctor for treatment. I also visited the
police station and reported the above.

    I have no knowledge of anything further and I did not see
the bombs thrown.

                                    Signed.
pages.zh:
钟庆福 (Zung Ching Foh)，53岁，海门人，
住戈登路（Gordon Rd.）401弄3号，受雇为该处马夫。

中央          1938年4月30日          ////           书记员 Sung
                                翻译

1938年4月30日上午10点左右，我将马车停在靠近外滩的苏州路上，约10分钟后，因汽车轮胎爆裂发出声响。紧接着我又听到一声爆炸，发现我的马受了伤。我的左臂也轻微受伤。随后，我的外籍主人指令我前往雷士德医院。从医院回来后，我将马送去医生处治疗。我也去了巡捕房报告了上述情况。

    我对其他情况一无所知，也没有看到炸弹被投掷。

                                    签名。

pages.en:
Tsoh Pee Sien,age 69,Canton,M/Unemployed,
residing at the Canton Refugee Centre,situated in the Tsing Liang
Sz Temple,Sinza Rd.
Central 30/4/38 //// Clerk Sung.
translated

On the 30/4/38 at about 10a.m. I happened to pass Foochow Rd.
bund on the north side pavement,when I suddenly heard two
explosive sounds. Then I felt pain on my right hand. I discovered
that blood was flowing on my hand and a policeman therefore
sent me to the hospital for treatment.
I have no knowledge of anything further,and I did not see
the bombs thrown.

Signed.
pages.zh:
曹培先 (Tsoh Pee Sien)，69岁，广东人，男/无业，
住新闸路（Sinza Rd.）清凉寺内的广东难民中心。
中央 1938年4月30日 //// 书记员 Sung。
翻译

1938年4月30日上午10点左右，我碰巧路过福州路外滩北侧人行道，突然听到两声爆炸声。随后我感到右手疼痛。我发现手上在流血，因此一名警察将我送往医院治疗。
我对其他情况一无所知，也没有看到炸弹被投掷。

签名。

pages.en:
Tsang Zang Tsing,age 45,native of Tungchow,
private ricsha coolie,residing at House 20
Shing Zung Li,Ningpo Rd.

Central 30/4/38 /// Clerk Sung.
translated

At about 10a.m. on the 30/4/38 I was pulling my master named
Zung Van Foo on the Bund S. to N. When I arrived at Foochow Rd.
and the Bund corner I suddenly heard an explosion. Then I was
informed by my master on the ricsha that my back was bleeding
and instructed to stop proceeding. Immediately after this I heard
a further explosion,so I put down the ricsha. A policeman
approached me and brought me to the station by a public ricsha.
Afterwards I was conveyed to the Lester Hospital.

I did not see the bombs thrown.

Signed.

X Not a victim 7 sup—
〔此处转录不清〕

（印：203 - 9 MAY 1938 SPECIAL BRANCH）
pages.zh:
曾张清 (Tsang Zang Tsing)，45岁，通州人，
私人黄包车夫，住宁波路兴宗里20号。

中央 1938年4月30日 /// 书记员 Sung。
翻译

1938年4月30日上午10点左右，我正拉着我的雇主钟万福 (Zung Van Foo) 在外滩由南向北行驶。当我到达福州路与外滩拐角处时，突然听到一声爆炸。随后车上的雇主告诉我背部在流血，并指令停止前行。紧接着我又听到一声爆炸，于是我放下了黄包车。一名警察走近我，用一辆公共黄包车将我带到巡捕房。之后我被转送至雷士德医院。

我没有看到炸弹被投掷。

签名。

X 非受害者 7 sup—
〔此处转录不清〕

（印：203 - 1938年5月9日 特别科）

pages.en:
Mao Sai Vung,age 34,native of Kompo,residing
House 31,Kwei Foh Li,Rue Bayle,F.C.

Central          30/4/38          ////          Clerk Sung.
                                translated

    At about 10.10a.m. on the 30/4/38 I was pulling my handtrolley
S.M.C. Lic. No. 4081 alongside The Bund S. to N. When nearing
Foochow Rd. I suddenly observed a long round article was whirling
on the roadway,which article I did not recognise. I then turned
West for 4 or 5 paces,when I heard an explosion,following which I
felt my left foot was wounded and bleeding. Then I was conveyed
to the station by a policeman,and in turn sent to the Lester
Hospital for treatment.
    I did not see who had thrown the bomb.
                                            Signed.
pages.zh:
毛赛云（Mao Sai Vung），34岁，金波（Kompo）人，住法租界贝勒路桂福里31号。

中央巡捕房          1938年4月30日          ////          书记员宋。
                                译

    1938年4月30日上午10时10分左右，我拉着工部局执照第4081号手推车，沿外滩由南向北行驶。当接近福州路时，我突然看到路上有一个长长的圆形物体在旋转，我不认识该物体。随后我向西走了四五步，这时听到一声爆炸，接着我感到左脚受伤流血。随后一名巡捕将我送往巡捕房，继而转送黎斯特医院（Lester Hospital）治疗。
    我没有看到是谁投掷了炸弹。
                                            签名。

pages.en:
Zung Vung Kwei.
xx D. S. I. Chang Ming Teh.
translated
/-------- Clerk Fan
Central Stn. 30-4-38

Zung Vung Kwei, aged 15 years, native of Wusih, student,
residing at No. 6 Sz Fong Lee, Shansi Road, states as
follows:-

At about 10e.m. on April 30th, 1938, when I was walking
together with my father Zung Tsang Sung on The Bund near Foochow
Road, I heard the sound of explosion twice coming from the western
direction and following which I felt pain on my leg. I then,
accompanied by my father, came to the Central Police Station and
made a report. I was subsequently conveyed to the hospital by a
police constable and after having received treatment I was discharged
from the hospital due to trivial injuries sustained. I know
nothing else besides the above. I did not see who threw the
bomb/s. This is my true statement.
Signed.
pages.zh:
曾云贵（Zung Vung Kwei）。
xx 副督察长张明德。
译
/-------- 书记员范
中央巡捕房 1938年4月30日

曾云贵（Zung Vung Kwei），15岁，无锡人，学生，住山西路四方里6号，陈述如下：-

1938年4月30日上午10时许，我与父亲曾藏松（Zung Tsang Sung）在外滩靠近福州路处行走时，听到西方传来两声爆炸声，随后我感到腿部疼痛。随后，我在父亲陪同下前往中央巡捕房报案。之后由一名巡佐送往医院，因伤势轻微，接受治疗后即出院。除上述情况外，我一无所知。我没有看到是谁投掷了炸弹。此乃本人真实供词。
签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 1534 Lah Ayoh Ming.

Central Stn.        30-4-38        xx self
                                   translated      Clerk Fan

At about 10.08a.m. on April 30th, 1938, whilst on duty at
the corner of Foochow Road and Bund, I heard an explosion
proceeding from the South-western corner. I did not see the
person who was responsible for the throwing of the 1st hand-grenade
Shortly after, I saw a male Chinese throw a hand-grenade the second
one, and it exploded on The Bund near Foochow Road corner. The
hand-grenade was thrown by the man with his right hand. Afterwards
this man, (Koo Ching Yoong) in question, ran in a southerly
direction and was eventually apprehended by me on The Bund about
30 yards north of Canton Road. After the arrest made by me,
C.P.C.s 1244, 2152, 2398 and 2992 all arrived at the scene, and
brought the man to the station.
                                              Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕警长 1534号 赖耀明（Lah Ayoh Ming）。

中央巡捕房        1938年4月30日        xx 自述
                                   译      书记员范

1938年4月30日上午10时08分左右，当我在福州路与外滩拐角处执勤时，听到西南角传来一声爆炸。我没有看到投掷第一枚手榴弹的人。不久后，我看到一名中国男子投掷了第二枚手榴弹，该手榴弹在外滩靠近福州路拐角处爆炸。该男子是用右手投掷的手榴弹。此后，这名涉案男子（顾正荣 (Koo Ching Yoong)）向南奔跑，最终被我于外滩广东路以北约30码处逮捕。在我实施逮捕后，华捕警长1244号、2152号、2398号和2992号均抵达现场，并将该男子带往巡捕房。
                                              签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 2992

Central          30/4/38          translated
                                  / //           Clerk Sung.

At about 10.08a.m. on the 30/4/38 whilst on duty at The Bund
I suddenly heard an explosion coming from West near Foochow Rd.
I immediately turned around and produced my pistol. At that time
I observed a male person wearing chocolate coloured long gown
running S. to N. who arriving at Foochow Rd. and the Bund raised
his right hand, following which an explosion took place. After
this, this person turned around and ran in a southerly direction.
I immediately gave chase and when I reached Canton Rd. and the
Bund this person was arrested by another Chinese policeman.
Then I rendered assistance to this C.P.C. and telephoned to the
station over the street telephone, reporting same. The arrested
person was consequently brought to the station.

                                              Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕警长 2992号

中央巡捕房          1938年4月30日          译
                                  / //           书记员宋。

1938年4月30日上午10时08分左右，当我在外滩执勤时，突然听到福州路附近西方传来一声爆炸。我立即转身并拔出手枪。当时我看到一名身穿巧克力色长衫的男子由南向北奔跑，到达福州路与外滩交界处时举起右手，随后发生爆炸。此后，该人转身向南奔跑。我立即追赶，当我到达广东路与外滩交界处时，该人被另一名中国巡捕逮捕。随后我协助该华捕警长，并通过街头电话向巡捕房报告此事。被捕者随即被带往巡捕房。

                                              签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 1244. Wong Nyah Seu.
xx self.
translated
Central Stn.      30-4-38      /--------      Clerk Fan

At about 10.08a.m. on April 30th, 1938, whilst on duty at the
Bund near Foochow, I heard the sound of two explosions and then
observed two men running in a southerly direction. I gave pursuit
along The Bund and about 30 yards north of Canton Road I together
with other constables arrested one man who was then brought to
station. This man is known as the 2nd accused. I did not see who
threw the bombs.
                                          Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕警长 1244号 黄亚修（Wong Nyah Seu）。
xx 自述。
译
中央巡捕房      1938年4月30日      /--------      书记员范

1938年4月30日上午10时08分左右，当我在靠近福州路的外滩执勤时，听到两声爆炸声，随后看到两名男子向南奔跑。我沿外滩追击，在广东路以北约30码处，我与其他巡捕一起逮捕了一名男子，随后将其带往巡捕房。此人被称为第二被告。我没有看到是谁投掷了炸弹。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 2152 Zau Kya Yung.
xx self
translated
/------
Central Stn.        30-4-38            Clerk Fan

Between 10a.m. and 4p.m. 30-4-38 I was posted on duty at The
Bund near Foochow Road and at about 10.05a.m., same date, I heard
the sound of an explosion. I later observed a man who was wearing
brown coloured long gown running in a northerly direction in front
of the China Merchants Steamship Navigation Coy. When this man
walked a few steps further, he lifted his right hand and threw
a hand-grenade in the vicinity. Shortly afterwards he turned about
and ran in a southerly direction. I then blew my police whistle
and made a pursuit. On arriving at the Bund near Canton Road the
man was apprehended with the assistance of C.P.C. 1594 and C.P.S.
3398 and escorted to the station. This man I later identified as
the 2nd accused. This is my true statement.

Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕警长 2152号 赵家荣（Zau Kya Yung）。
xx 自述
译
/------
中央巡捕房        1938年4月30日            书记员范

1938年4月30日上午10时至下午4时之间，我在靠近福州路的外滩执勤，同日约上午10时05分，我听到一声爆炸。随后我看到一名身穿棕色长衫的男子在招商局轮船公司门前向北奔跑。该男子又走了几步后，举起右手向附近投掷了一枚手榴弹。不久后他转身向南奔跑。我随即吹响警笛并展开追捕。到达靠近广东路的外滩时，在华捕警长1594号和华捕警员3398号的协助下将该男子逮捕，并押送至巡捕房。我后来确认此人为第二被告。此乃本人真实供词。

签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 3398 Liu Lau Loong.
xx self
translated
Central Stn.        30-4-38        /--------        Clerk Fan

At 10.08a.m. on April 30th, 1938, whilst patrolling on the
No. 6 Pontoon, The Bund, near Foochow Road, I heard an explosion
and observed the smoke proceeding from the north of the China
Merchants Steamship Navigation Coy. The Bund near Foochow Road.
Another hand-grenade was seen to be thrown by some men into
Foochow Road, and shortly afterwards they decamped in a southerly
direction. I immediately took my service pistol in hand and,
accompanied by C.P.C. 2152, pursued along The Bund. Upon arriving
at the Bund near Canton Road, where C.P.C. 1594 was performing his
post duty there and with his assistance I and C.P.C. 2152 apprehend-
ed the accused and brought to Station. I did not see who threw
the bombs.
                                Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕警长 3398号 刘老龙（Liu Lau Loong）。
xx 自述
译
中央巡捕房        1938年4月30日        /--------        书记员范

1938年4月30日上午10时08分，当我在靠近福州路的外滩6号浮码头巡逻时，听到一声爆炸，并看到烟雾从靠近福州路的外滩招商局轮船公司北侧冒出。还看到有人向福州路投掷了另一枚手榴弹，随后他们向南逃窜。我立即手持配枪，与华捕警长2152号一同沿外滩追击。到达靠近广东路的外滩时，华捕警长1594号正在那里岗位执勤，在其协助下，我与华捕警长2152号逮捕了被告，并将其带往巡捕房。我没有看到是谁投掷了炸弹。

pages.en:
Central Police
30th, April 38.

Bomb thrown on The Bund.

Inspector Lees

Sir;

At 10.10 a.m. on the 30th April 1938 the undersigned was ascending the ramp leading from No.6 Municipal Pontoon situated at the corner of The Bund and Foochow Road, when he heard a loud explosion which seemed to come from the West side of The Bund near Foochow Road, I ran to the top of the ramp and saw a thin blue haze of smoke outside the Foochow Road entrance of the Shanghai & Hongkong Bank building, and at this moment another explosion took place on The Bund a little South of Foochow Road.

I immediately drew my automatic and loaded whilst running to the scene of the second explosion, and at this moment I saw a male Chinese, dressed in a long blue gown, hatless, running from North to South along The Bund, a ricsha coolie pointed out the man as having thrown the bomb. I immediately gave chase, he ran East across The Bund, crossing onto the New Bund Rd. I then saw F.S.240 Albon running from South to North to intercept the man.

The Chinese seeing that F.S.240 Albon was coming from the opposite direction to which he was running, crossed between the parked M/Cars to reach the Main Bund Road, but F.S.240 Albon seeing his move, did the same, with the result that the Chinese ran right into F.S.240 Albon as he was emerging from the parked cars, and F.S.240 Albon managed to arrest him, the undersigned coming up immediately after.

The other male Chinese who had also thrown a bomb was arrested at the scene of the explosion by C.P.C.1594 on traffic duty at The Bund Foochow Road. C.P.C.1244, on beat duty on The Bund, also C.P.C.2152 on No.6 Municipal Pontoon.

Both men were then brought to the Station.

D.O. "A" Division.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔此处转录不清〕
pages.zh:
中央巡捕房
1938年4月30日。

外滩投掷炸弹案。

李斯（Lees）督察

先生；

1938年4月30日上午10时10分，卑职正走上位于外滩与福州路拐角处的6号市立浮码头的引桥，此时听到一声巨大的爆炸声，似乎来自靠近福州路的外滩西侧。我跑上引桥顶端，看到上海汇丰银行大楼福州路入口处外有一层淡淡的蓝色烟雾，就在此时，外滩福州路稍南侧发生了另一次爆炸。

我立即拔出自动手枪并在跑向第二次爆炸现场时装填子弹，此时我看到一名未戴帽子、身穿蓝色长衫的中国男子沿外滩由北向南奔跑，一名人力车夫指认该男子为投掷炸弹者。我立即展开追捕，他向东横穿外滩，跑上新外滩路。随后我看到外籍警员240号阿尔本（Albon）由南向北跑来拦截该男子。

该中国人看到外籍警员240号阿尔本从他奔跑的相反方向过来，便穿过停放的摩托车之间以到达外滩主路，但外籍警员240号阿尔本看到他的举动后也做了同样的动作，结果该中国人在从停放的车辆中穿出时正好撞上了外籍警员240号阿尔本，外籍警员240号阿尔本成功将其逮捕，卑职随即赶到。

另一名同样投掷了炸弹的中国男子在外滩福州路交通执勤的华捕警长1594号于爆炸现场逮捕。在外滩巡逻的华捕警长1244号，以及在6号市立浮码头的华捕警长2152号也参与了行动。

两人随后被带往巡捕房。

“A”分区值班警官。
先生，
您的顺从仆人，
〔此处转录不清〕

pages.en:
FM. 2
G. 55M-1.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Central ............Station,
REPORT
Date April 30th, 1938

Subject Hand Grenades Explosions which occurred on The Bund near Foochow
Road on 30-4-38.

Made by F.S.240 Albon, Forwarded by....................................................

Sir;
I have to report that at about 10.10 a.m. 30-4-38, whilst
on duty on the Bund jetties and whilst standing at the entrance
to No.4 Pontoon, I heard a loud explosion come from the direct-
ion of the Bund and Foochow Road. I looked in that direction
and observed a blue smoke haze as if from a M/Car exhaust, at
the same time I heard a second explosion and observed people
running in all directions. I immediately drew my pistol and ran
out onto the road opposite No.4 Pontoon where my attention was
attracted to a male Chinese without a hat, wearing a long blue
gown and carrying a rolled up Chinese newspaper in his left hand
who was being chased from North to South along the Bund by
Inspector Lees and another male Chinese (who appeared to be of
the ricksha coolie class) The latter was pointing at the man in
the long blue gown and calling out that he was one of the men.
At this time the accused Tse Zung Tsoong ( ), 28,
Quinsan, S/Unemployed, N P.A. observed me and made as if to turn
West in between some M/Cars parked in a line at that spot.
At that time I was about 10 yards away from the accused and as I
saw that he was unarmed I immediately leaped towards him and
held him and searched him. Inspector Lees came up just after
and the accused was taken to station by Inspector Lees and my-
self. Another male Chinese without a hat and wearing a long
black gown was arrested a few yards from the scene of the
explosions by some C.P.Cs. and taken to the Station.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. L. Albon
F.S.240

D.O. "A" Div.
pages.zh:
FM. 2
G. 55M-1.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____ 
中央 ____ 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1938年4月30日

事由：1938年4月30日发生在靠近福州路的外滩的手榴弹爆炸事件。

呈报人：外籍警员240号阿尔本（Albon），转发人 ____ 

先生；
卑职谨报告，1938年4月30日上午10时10分左右，卑职在外滩码头执勤，站在4号浮码头入口处时，听到一声巨大的爆炸声来自外滩和福州路方向。我向该方向望去，观察到一团蓝色烟雾，仿佛来自汽车尾气，同时听到第二声爆炸，并看到人们四处奔逃。我立即拔出手枪，跑到4号浮码头对面的马路上，此时我的注意力被一名未戴帽子、身穿蓝色长衫、左手拿着一份卷起的中文报纸的中国男子吸引，他正被李斯（Lees）督察和另一名中国男子（看似属于人力车夫阶层）沿外滩由北向南追赶。后者指着那名穿蓝色长衫的男子，大声喊叫说他是其中一名作案者。此时，被告谢宗松（Tse Zung Tsoong）（ ），28岁，昆山人，无业，非上海居民，发现了我，并假装要向西转入停在那裡的一排摩托车之间。当时我距离被告约10码，见其未携带武器，我立即向他扑去，将其按住并进行搜身。李斯督察随即赶到，被告由李斯督察和卑职带往巡捕房。另一名未戴帽子、身穿黑色长衫的中国男子在距离爆炸现场几码远处被几名华捕警长逮捕，并带往巡捕房。

先生，
您的顺从仆人，
J. L. 阿尔本
外籍警员240号

“A”分区值班警官。

At 10.13a.m. 30-4-38 a telephone message was
received through extension No. 6 from C.P.C. 2992
reporting to the effect that a hand-grenade had
been thrown and exploded on The Bund near Soochow
Road and requesting the services of an ambulance.
The S.P.B. W/ambulance was immediately called for
and the above named detectives immediately proceeded
to scene, where it was found that two hand-grenades
had been thrown by two male Chinese as follows:-

(1) Ts Zung Isoong (薛仁厚), 28, Quinsan,
S/unemployed, N.F.A.

(2) Koo Ching Yoong (顧金榮), 18, Footung,
S/unemployed, residing at 167 Ng Yue
Li, Route Jesteian, F.C.

who were arrested while attempting to escape from
the scene after having thrown the grenades. The
1st accused was arrested by Inspt. Lees and P.S. 240
Albon while the 2nd accused was arrested by C.P.C.
1594. As result of the explosion of the two hand-
grenades the following persons were injured and
received treatment at the Lester Chinese Hospital:-

1. Miso San Vung (三文), age 34, Kompo,
Handtrolley coolie, no. 31 Kwei Foh Li,
Rue Admiral Bayle, F.C. Bomb wound left
leg. Not serious. 14 days treatment O.P.D.

2. Tsang Kung Fah (張公發), age 24, Kompo,
S/hawker, rootung, Bomb wound chest, not
serious. 5 days O.P.D.

3. Tso Pee Sih (曹皮先), age 69, Canton,
W/godown keeper, refugee camp, Medhurst
Road. Bomb wound arm, not serious. 14
days treatment O.P.D.

1938年4月30日上午10:13，通过分机6号收到来自中央巡捕房2992号的电话留言，报告称在外滩近苏州路处有人投掷并引爆了一枚手榴弹，并请求派遣救护车。立即呼叫了警务处救护车，上述侦探随即赶赴现场，发现两枚手榴弹是由两名中国男子投掷的，具体如下：-

(1) Ts Zung Isoong (薛仁厚)，28岁，昆山籍，单身/无业，非本埠居民 (N.F.A.)。

(2) Koo Ching Yoong (顧金榮)，18岁，浦东籍，单身/无业，住法租界杰斯特安路（Route Jesteian）鸿源里167号。

二人在投掷手榴弹后试图逃离现场时被逮捕。第一名被告由 Lees 督察和警士240号 Albon 逮捕，第二名被告由中央巡捕房1594号逮捕。由于两枚手榴弹爆炸，以下人员受伤并在莱斯华医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）接受治疗：-

1. Miso San Vung (三文)，34岁，高邮籍，人力车夫，住法租界贝勒路（Rue Admiral Bayle）桂芳里31号。左腿炸弹伤。不严重。门诊治疗14天。

2. Tsang Kung Fah (張公發)，24岁，高邮籍，单身/小贩，浦东籍。胸部炸弹伤，不严重。门诊治疗5天。

3. Tso Pee Sih (曹皮先)，69岁，广东籍，寡妇/仓库看守员，麦特赫斯特路难民营。手臂炸弹伤，不严重。门诊治疗14天。

A thorough examination was immediately made of the
scene and as a result twenty pieces of hand-grenade
fragments were found in the immediate vicinity of The
Bund and Foochow Road corner.

At 11.30a.m. a message was received by telephone
from Major Bourne U.C. by D.S.I. Ovsianikoff
instructing him to proceed to the Office of The China
Merchants Steamship Coy. and to see Mr. W. Hunt.
Mr. Hunt handed to D.S.I. Ovsianikoff two small grenade
fragments picked up by Mr. Hunt in the above office
which had pierced a pane of glass in the window over-
looking the Bund. (Eighteen pieces picked up outside in
the vicinity of the above premises and two pieces found
as explained above, total twenty pieces).

Scene of crime.

Corner of The Bund and Foochow Road, outside the premises of William Hunt & Coy. According to the 1st and 2nd accused the individual whom they intended to murder left the Commercial Bank of China by the front door and boarded a private ricsha which proceeded north along The Bund for about 30 yards and turned into Foochow Road to proceed west. The 1st and 2nd accused armed with the hand-grenades upon a given signal on the part of an accomplice ran towards the private ricsha and threw the grenades. One grenade struck the ground, apparently at the rear of the ricsha, about 25 yards north of the front door of the bank, whilst the other grenade struck the ground on the north side of Foochow Road about 10 yards west of the corner of Foochow Road and The Bund. The second grenade was thrown, it is thought, whilst the private ricsha was turning into Foochow Road from The Bund. As far as is known at present this attempt to murder the occupant of the private ricsha, who remains unknown, was unsuccessful, the private ricsha continuing on its course along Foochow Road where it disappeared. The number of the private ricsha was not obtained. No reports of any injured persons receiving treatment in any hospital in the Settlement, apart from those numerated above, have

犯罪现场。

外滩与福州路转角，William Hunt & Coy. 公司处所外。据第一和第二被告称，他们意图谋杀的对象从中国银行正门离开，登上一辆私人人力车，沿外滩向北行驶约30码，随后转入福州路向西行驶。第一和第二被告手持手榴弹，在同伙发出信号后，跑向该私人人力车并投掷手榴弹。一枚手榴弹击中地面，位置似乎在人力车后方，距银行正门以北约25码处；另一枚手榴弹击中地面，位置在福州路北侧，距外滩与福州路转角以西约10码处。据推测，第二枚手榴弹是在私人人力车从外滩转入福州路时投掷的。就目前所知，这次谋杀私人人力车乘客（身份仍不明）的企图未能成功，该私人人力车继续沿福州路行驶并消失。未获取该私人人力车的号码。除上述列举的人员外，未收到租界内任何医院收治受伤人员的报告。

A Hankow report that fragments

外滩手榴弹事件。
南京路熊记
日本字符

据汉口方面报告，5月1日投掷于南京路的手榴弹碎片，以及早前在外滩投向日本海军人员的一枚榴霰弹壳上，均刻有日本字符“Ishii”。日本发言人今晨暗示，这并非完全不可能。
他解释说，该字符与广州一家中国兵工厂使用的字符相同。他回顾说，日本飞机曾多次轰炸该兵工厂。然而，该发言人拒绝否认这些弹药是日本制造，因为他“未曾见过警方手中的碎片”。
针对有关近期上海事件中投掷的手榴弹标有三井（Mitsui）商标的说法，该发言人回答说，三井财团并不生产军火。

J. S. Henderson 6/5

FURTHER May 17th, 38

Hand grenade explosion at the corner of Nanking and Kweichow Roads
on 1-5-38.

D.S. MacLennan.

Sir,

With reference to report dated 4-5-38, page 1, paragraph 3,
the letter signed "K.W.L." was forwarded to the Threatening
Letter Registry (C.5) on 2-5-38 and, as a result of an examina-
tion of same by Clerk May Yoh a report was received at this
station on 10-5-38 with the following remarks :-

"Hand writing identified with an anonymous letter addressed
to Headquarters, S.M.P., dated 3-4-38."

A translation of the letter, in question, addressed to
Headquarters, is as follows :-

"To Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

Sirs,
I sent you a note on a previous occasion, which must
have already reached you. Why should I bother reiterating?
Yesterday I was in the greatest danger for I was also in
the Grand Hotel at that time. Subsequently a secret report
was received to the effect that a large party of Japanese
and traitors attempted to arrest me at a certain time. I
did not get excited, nor was I flurried. I took out my
"first life" and a bomb, ready to risk my own life in face
of danger. They were lucky that they did not actually come.
Again I must warn the Council for being immodest and taking
sides with the brutal Japanese military who act contrary to
law. Let me speak a word of impartiality; the Police Force
of the Council might be handed over to their control. You
can only insult coolies and our innocent people but what can
you do with the Japanese. Your future is doomed. Beware of
being bombed! Good-bye! Good-bye!
(Signed) : K. W. L."

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH * 18 MAY 1938 *）

Continued enquiries by the detective staff of this station,
including C.D.S. 85 and C.D.C. 116 who were specially detailed
to investigate the case, have failed to produce any information
as to the identity of the person/s responsible for the throwing
of the grenade, or as to the writer of the letters. No further
witnesses have been located and no further developments have
taken place in connection with the case.

（批：Dec B. ... S.I. ...）

Sen. Det. 1/c D.S. MacLennan

“笔迹确认为一封寄往工部局警务处总部、日期为1938年4月3日的匿名信。”

该致总部信件的译文如下：-

“致警察部，
上海工部局，

先生们，
我此前曾给你们去过一封信，想必你们已经收到。何必再费口舌重述？昨天我处于极大的危险之中，因为当时我也在大华饭店。随后收到一份秘密报告，称有一大批日本人和汉奸企图在某个时间逮捕我。我没有激动，也没有惊慌。我拿出了我的‘第一条命’和一枚炸弹，准备在危险面前冒生命危险。他们很幸运，实际上并没有来。我必须再次警告工部局不要傲慢，不要偏袒行事违法的残暴日军。让我说一句公道话；工部局的警察部队可能会落入他们的控制之下。你们只能侮辱苦力和我们无辜的百姓，但对日本人又能怎样呢？你们的未来注定灭亡。小心被炸！再见！再见！
（签名）：K. W. L.”

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 * 1938年5月18日 *）

Hand grenade explosion at the corner of Nanking and Kweichow Roads
on 1-5-38.

D.S. MacLennan.

Sir,

On the morning of 5-5-38, a typed letter, dated 2-5-38 was
received, per post, at this station and reads as follows :-

"The Inspector of Louza Police Station Esq.,
Dear Sir,
I am a Russian subject who was at the scene
when the bombing accident was happened at the South Eastern
corner of Kweichow and Nanking Roads at about quarter past
five on Sunday afternoon, the 1st inst., I take my liberty
to be upright and straight in stating as follows :-
One second before the hand grenade exploded,
I was just crossing the street of Nanking Road from North
to South and noticed one triwheeled motor cycle running
before one yellow truck without license from West to East.
When I was at the midst of the road, I turned my head back
and saw S.P. 259, Brady riding a cycle with a C.P. in the
side car in the front of a moving non-licensed truck with
two Japanese uniforms standing on, one on the North side
and one on the South side of the truck which was only five
yards distant from the front cycle. I, at that time, found
the North side one suddenly raising his right hand and
slightly tossing, not throwing, one thing off from his hand,
thus caused its accident shortly. No sooner the bombing
was explored, the S.P. stopped the cycle to investigate the
case and was with his eyes daring at the passerby, but the
truck was still forewarded steadily as usual. In this
point of view, there is nothing to be in doubt to search
the pedestrians thereabout.
At present, the Japanese marines forced to
station in your office today but what the Japanese authority
is going to do next, the council must pay more attention to.
I do not think that so clear the Council is, would be fooled
by them, and I believe that the Council must have a best
scheme to stop their purposed action and intention in the
Settlement. If not, the population here about forty hundred
thousand people who will be all accumulated by them. All
the foreign emmigrants and Chinese civilians wholly depend
upon the Council's protection. You should take more pains
to the public safety in the necessity of your everlong
Settlement.
Hoping to trust me and accept my opinion
suggested.
I am, Sir,
Yours trustworthily,
(signed and typed) N. MARISKY "

The letter bears no address : The envelope shows the Bubbling
Well Post Office mark.

Boarding House Sections of the S.M.P. and French Police but the

先生：

1938年5月5日上午，本警署通过邮政收到一封打字信件，日期为1938年5月2日，内容如下：-

“致老闸捕房督察先生台鉴，
亲爱的先生，
我是一名俄国侨民，本月1日（星期日）下午五时一刻左右，当贵州路与南京路东南角发生炸弹事故时，我在现场。我冒昧直陈如下：
在手榴弹爆炸前一秒，
我正从北向南穿越南京路马路，注意到一辆无牌照的黄色卡车前有一辆三轮摩托车由西向东行驶。当我走到路中间时，我回头看见巡捕259号Brady骑着一辆摩托车，边斗里坐着一名中国巡捕，在一辆行驶中的无牌照卡车前方，卡车上站着两名身穿日本制服的人，一个在卡车北侧，一个在南侧，距离前面的摩托车仅五码远。当时，我发现北侧那人突然举起右手，轻微地（而非用力投掷）从手中抛出一物，随即导致了事故的发生。爆炸发生后，该巡捕停下摩托车调查案件，并大胆地盯着路人看，但那辆卡车仍像往常一样稳步向前行驶。从这个角度来看，搜查周围的行人是毫无疑问的。
目前，日本海军陆战队被迫驻扎在你们的办公室，但日本当局下一步要做什么，工部局必须更加注意。我不认为如此清白的工部局会被他们愚弄，我相信工部局一定有最好的方案来阻止他们在租界内的预定行动和意图。否则，这里大约四十万人口都将受其积聚之害。所有外国移民和中国平民完全依赖工部局的保护。为了你们长久的租界，你们应在必要时为公共安全付出更多努力。
希望能信任我并接受我的建议。
此致，
您忠实的，
（签名并打字）N. MARISKY ”

该信没有地址：信封上显示静安寺邮局邮戳。

询问了几名俄国侦探，他们表示没有叫“Marisky”的俄国名字。

老闸捕房与日本宪兵队合作进行进一步的搜索行动。

1938年5月4日下午3点10分至5点30分之间，White督察及其随行人员， accompanied by eight plain clothes members of the Japanese Gendarmerie（由八名便衣日本宪兵队员陪同），巡视了虞洽卿路、爱多亚路、云南路、广西路和北海路，搜查了五辆无轨电车。

进入虞洽卿路的大华饭店，在336房间发现一本小册子，涉嫌具有反日性质。（参见老闸捕房杂项报告356/38）。

查询正在进行中。

D. M. MAC LENNAN
D. S. 10

高级侦探主管

D. D. O. "A"

officer in S. P. Branch
Misc. 148/38
Louza
May 4, 38

Further
Hand grenade explosion at the corner of Nanking and Kweichow Roads
on 1-5-38.
D.S. MacLennan

Sir,
At 5.10 p.m. 2-5-38, Mr. A. Thomas of the Shipping Department, Tsoong Tobacco Co., North Soochow Road, called at the office of Det. Supt. MacDermott, P.A. (Crime) and stated that he was driving West on Nanking Road and was opposite the Wing On Dept. Store, Nanking Road entrance, when the hand grenade exploded.

He saw the smoke from the explosion rising from the area in which motor cars are ranked (the South side). About the same time a motor truck driven by a Japanese and carrying about three Japanese sailors came from behind a tramcar at a very fast rate proceeding towards the Bund (East). The driver was actually accelerating his speed when seen by Mr. Thomas. To pass round the tram the driver of the motor truck crossed the road from his proper side to the wrong side. Mr. Thomas could not state whence the bomb was thrown. He does not know the number of the motor truck.

(A report on the above was forwarded by Det. Supt. MacDermott to this station).

At 10.30 a.m. 4-5-38, an anonymous letter, dated 3-5-38, was received at this station. It is pencil written in Chinese characters and, when translated, reads as follows :-

"Louza Police Station Staff,
There is no necessity for investigations as I threw the bomb on Nanking Road.
Should the Japanese troops continue to act so wildly in the Settlement I cannot give assurance against a re-occurrence in the future. May the Settlement authorities take note of this.

(Sgd). K.W.L."

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 5 MAY 1938 SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：desk B / 575 / C 5/4 / 28/5/45 pages）

1938年5月4日

续报
1938年5月1日南京路与贵州路转角处手榴弹爆炸案。
D.S. MacLennan

先生，
1938年5月2日下午5点10分，北苏州路宗福烟草公司航运部的A. Thomas先生到访犯罪科助理总监MacDermott先生的办公室，陈述称：当时他正驾车沿南京路西行，行至南京路入口处的永安百货对面时，手榴弹爆炸。

他看到爆炸产生的烟雾从停放汽车的区域（南侧）升起。大约在同一时间，一辆由日本人驾驶、载有约三名日本水兵的摩托卡车从一辆电车后方高速驶出，朝外滩（东）方向行进。Thomas先生看到时，司机正在加速。为了绕过电车，摩托卡车司机从正确的一侧车道跨越到了逆行车道。Thomas先生无法说明炸弹是从何处投掷的。他不知道那辆摩托卡车的车牌号。

（关于上述情况的报告已由助理总监MacDermot转发至本警署）。

1938年5月4日上午10点30分，本警署收到一封匿名信，日期为1938年5月3日。该信用铅笔以中文书写，译文如下：-

“老闸捕房全体同仁，
无需调查，南京路的炸弹是我投的。
如果日军继续在租界内如此猖獗行事，我不能保证将来不会再次发生类似事件。望租界当局注意此事。

（签名）. K.W.L.”

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 - 1938年5月5日 特别处）
（批：desk B / 575 / C 5/4 / 28/5/45 pages）

The envelope, which bears the Carter Road Sub-Post Office
mark, is addressed :- Officer i/c Louza Police Station, Inter-
national Settlement, Local.

On the reverse side of the envelope is written :- "Attention
to Postmen! We are not proud and we will not be subdued !!
Ready to sacrifice."

The letter appears to have been written by a person of
fair education and although it contains no clue on which
enquiries might be based it is being forwarded to Headquarters
for examination.

As precautionary measures the following search parties
operated in this district on 3 and 4-5-38.

1. Between 4.40 p.m. and 6.10 p.m. 3-5-38, Inspector
Williamson and party accompanied by three plain clothes members
of the Japanese Gendarmerie examined the following hotels :-
(1) Great Eastern Hotel, Kin Wo Ka; (2) Oriental Hotel, Nanking
Road, and (3) Shanghai Hotel, Tientsin Road.

In room 238 of the latter establishment two Chinese novels
containing two leaflets were found.. These novels were written
by a Japanese author and the leaflets were advertising the books
The four Chinese occupants of the room were questioned and stated
that they had connection with the Japanese Military Intelligence
Department, New Asia Hotel.

The Japanese Gendarmerie members who accompanied Inspector
Williamson took a copy of the books, more from a point of view
of curiosity than anything else.

Inspector Williamson did not object because if these books
had contained any anti-Japaneseism, the Gendarmerie would have
requested the arrest of the occupants.

- 2 -

信封上盖有卡特路支局邮戳，收件人地址为：国际租界本地，老闸捕房主管警官。

信封背面写有：“注意邮差！我们不傲慢，也不会被征服！！随时准备牺牲。”

此信似乎由一位受过良好教育的人所写，虽然信中没有任何可供调查的线索，但仍已送交总局审查。

作为预防措施，下列搜查队于1938年5月3日和4日在本区行动。

1. 1938年5月3日下午4时40分至6时10分，威廉姆森（Williamson）巡官及其随行人员，在三名便衣日本宪兵的陪同下，检查了以下旅馆：(1) 大东酒店（Kin Wo Ka）；(2) 南京路东方酒店；以及 (3) 天津路上海酒店。

在后一家机构的238号房间内，发现两本中文小说，其中夹有两张传单。这些小说由一位日本作者撰写，传单则是为这些书籍做广告。房间内的四名中国住客受到讯问，并称他们与日本军事情报部及新亚酒店有关联。

陪同威廉姆森巡官的日本宪兵拿走了书籍副本，这更多是出于好奇而非其他原因。

威廉姆森巡官并未反对，因为如果这些书籍包含任何反日内容，宪兵队会要求逮捕住客。

Further Report
Misc. 348/38.
Louza
May 3, 38.

Hand Grenade Explosion at the Corner of Nanking and Kwangchow Roads.
on 1-5-38.

D.C. McLennan.
Chief Inspectori/o.

Sir,

At 2.30 p.m. on 2-5-38, P.C. 259, Bruce, Bubbling Well
Station, came to this station and made the following statement:-

"At about 5.15 p.m. on 1-5-38, I was proceeding East on
Nanking Road immediately in front of a Japanese Naval M/truck
and when near the corner of Kwangse Road, I heard a loud
explosion which was followed by Chinese pedestrians shouting
that a bomb had been thrown.

I drew to the North West corner of Kwangse and Nanking
Roads and immediately commenced searching persons proceeding
East along the North footpath.

The Motor truck, with a few Japanese sailors standing on
the rear, stopped for a second, and then continued East at a
fast speed."

(Referring to original Report, page 4, para 3, Mr. G.L.
Hitchison's statement slightly contradicts the above inasmuch
that he states that the truck continued without stopping).

At 2.40 p.m. 2-5-38, Mr. G.V. Symmerberg, 264 Kiangse Road,
came to the station and stated that at about 5.15 p.m. 1-5-38,
he was travelling in an omnibus which was moving away in an
Easterly direction along Nanking Road when he heard the explosion.
About five seconds later, smoke was observed to rise from the
south side of the road, apparently from the footpath. A Japanese
military M/truck had passed the scene about ten seconds prior
to the explosion.

At 3 p.m. on 3-5-38, the undersigned was informed by the
D.D.O."A" through C.D.I. Sharman to the effect that Mr. S.K.
Chao, clerk in the Sun Ya Restaurant, 719 Nanking Road and
Mr. Rath(American)attached to the Orient Cigar Company, 137
Nanking Road, might be able to supply information of assistance.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH - 4 MAY 1938）

（批：S. 1.）
（批：D.B.Q.）
（批：4/5'）

老闸
1938年5月3日.

1938年5月1日南京路与江西路转角处手榴弹爆炸案.

麦克伦南（McLennan）副督察.
主管首席巡官.

先生，

1938年5月2日下午2时30分，静安寺捕房第259号警员布鲁斯（Bruce）来到本站，作出如下陈述：

“1938年5月1日下午5时15分左右，我正沿南京路向东行进，紧跟在一辆日本海军摩托卡车前方，当接近江西路转角时，我听到一声巨大的爆炸声，随后听到中国行人高喊有人投掷了炸弹。

我走到江西路与南京路的西北角，并立即开始搜查沿北侧人行道向东行走的人员。

那辆摩托卡车，后部站着几名日本水兵，停顿了一秒钟，然后快速继续向东行驶。”

（参照原始报告第4页第3段，G.L. Hitchison先生的陈述与上述内容略有矛盾，因为他称卡车未停车即继续行驶）。

1938年5月2日下午2时40分，江西路264号的G.V. Symmerberg先生来到警局，陈述称1938年5月1日下午5时15分左右，他正乘坐一辆公共汽车沿南京路向东行驶，此时听到了爆炸声。约五秒钟后，观察到烟雾从道路南侧升起，显然来自人行道。一辆日本军用摩托卡车在爆炸前约十秒钟经过了现场。

1938年5月3日下午3时，经C.D.I. Sharman转达，“A”区副总监告知下述签署人，南京路719号新雅餐厅（Sun Ya Restaurant）的职员赵先生（S.K. Chao，音译）和南京路137号东方雪茄公司（Orient Cigar Company）的美籍雇员拉斯先生（Mr. Rath，音译）可能能够提供有助益的信息。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科 - 1938年5月4日）
（批：C. 4/5）
（批：S. 1.）
（批：D.B.Q.）

- 2 -

C.D.C. 18 and the undersigned accordingly interviewed
Mr. Cheo, who stated that at the time the explosion occurred he
was in an upstairs room of the restaurant and therefore he did
not witness the incident. He subsequently learned news in
general regarding the incident but not as to who had thrown the
bomb. It was learned that at the time the grenade was thrown
there were no Japanese in the Restaurant but about fifteen
minutes later, ten male Japanese in civilian clothes arrived
and occupied two tables which they had previously booked. The
names or address of these Japanese are unknown.

Further enquiries revealed that the premises have been
patronized to a great extent by Japanese recently.

Examples:- Between 12 noon and 1.30 p.m. 2-5-38 two tables were
occupied by twelve members of the Shanghai Scientific
Institute, Route Ghisi, French Concession, who wore
black uniforms.
Between 12 noon and 1.30 p.m. today (3-5-38) twelve
members of the Yokohama Specie Bank partook of food.
Eight tables are booked in the Restaurant for 6 p.m.
today (3-5-38) by members of the Manchurian Railway
Company.
Apart from the above numerous individuals and couples
have had food in the restaurant yesterday and today,
as on previous dates.

In view of this recent patronisation by Japanese and the
fact that the explosion occurred within thirty feet of the
restaurant, on the same side, it might appear possible that the
grenade was thrown in way of intimidation.

The management of the restaurant, however, state that they
have received no threatening letters and nothing untoward happen-
ed in the restaurant or in the vicinity prior to the explosion.

The said detectives then interviewed Mr. Roth and met with
a storm of anti-Police feelings from him. He alleged that his
pages.zh:
- 2 -

C.D.C. 18和下述签署人随即讯问了赵先生（Cheo，音译），他表示爆炸发生时他在餐厅的楼上房间内，因此未目睹事件经过。他随后得知了关于该事件的一般消息，但不知是谁投掷了炸弹。据悉，投掷手榴弹时餐厅内没有日本人，但大约十五分钟后，十名身穿便服的日本男子到达，并占据了他们此前预订的两张桌子。这些日本人的姓名或地址不详。

进一步调查显示，近期日本人经常光顾该场所。

例如：1938年5月2日中午12时至下午1时30分之间，两张桌子被十二名身穿黑色制服的法租界祁齐路（Route Ghisi）上海科学研究所成员占用。
今天（1938年5月3日）中午12时至下午1时30分之间，十二名横滨正金银行成员在此用餐。
满铁公司（Manchurian Railway Company）成员已为今天（1938年5月3日）下午6时在餐厅预订了八张桌子。
除上述情况外，昨天和今天有许多个人和情侣在该餐厅用餐，与此前日期一样。

鉴于近期日本人频繁光顾，且爆炸发生在距离餐厅同侧三十英尺以内，手榴弹可能是作为一种恐吓手段被投掷的。

然而，餐厅管理层表示，他们未收到任何威胁信件，且在爆炸前餐厅内或附近未发生任何异常事件。

上述侦探随后讯问了罗斯先生（Roth，音译），却遭到其强烈的反警察情绪对待。他声称他的

pages.en:

wife had been assaulted by a Portuguese in the Bubbling Well
District recently and that Police refused to take any action
in the matter. He added that should he be in possession of
important information in regard to the explosion he would
certainly be the last person to reveal same to Police.
Enquiries proceeding.

〔此处转录不清〕
Sen. Det. 1/c

D. S. 10

D. D. O. "A"

Louza
May 2nd., 38.
S.M.P.
Hand Grenade Explosion at the Corner of Nanking and Kweichow Roads,
on 1-5-38.

D.C.I. Smith Chief Inspector.

Sir,

Further to D.C.I. Report No.348/38 rendered on the 1-5-38,
the following Japanese subjects remained in premises occupied
by the Sun Ya Restaurant Nanking Road between 12.m.n. 1-5-38 and
7.a.m. 2-5-38.

Six Japanese soldiers, three Japanese civilians (believed
to be members of the Secret Service Corp) and three Japanese
members of the M.P. Police, whilst a further six Japanese soldiers
slept in a room adjoining the main dining room. (Refreshments from
the Single Men's Mess were supplied to the latter during the
night).

Beginning at 9.p.m. 2-5-38, two Japanese Military
sentries (one armed with rifle) were posted outside the Sun
Ya Restaurant Nanking Road, one S.M.P. and one J.M.P. being
also detailed by the Officer-in-Charge Road Station for duty
in the vicinity of the said Restaurant. With reference to the
Japanese sentries these were relieved hourly by Japanese
soldiers posted in loose fashion.

Duties on Nanking Road were augmented by a number of
C.M.C.s who were placed at regulated distances apart, whilst a
Foreign Sergeant was also detailed for duty outside of the Sun
Sun Company and opposite to the Sun Ya Restaurant.

In addition to the above, special patrols of Foreign and
Chinese detectives were detailed by C.A.I. Sharman to patrol and
keep observation in the vicinity, paying special attention to
passing Japanese Military and Naval vehicles.

At 11.45.a.m. 2-5-38 a detachment of Seaforth Highlanders
arrived at Nanking and Kiangse Road in several military trucks,
and after sentries had been posted as follows:

26 (J.C.)
348/38.
-5-38.
老闸
1938年5月2日.
S.M.P.
1938年5月1日南京路与贵州路转角处手榴弹爆炸案.

史密斯（Smith）副督察 首席巡官.

先生，

继1938年5月1日提交的第348/38号副督察报告之后，以下日本人在1938年5月1日中午12时至1938年5月2日上午7时期间，停留在南京路新雅餐厅所占用的 premises 内。

六名日本士兵，三名日本平民（据信为特务机关成员）以及三名日本军警（M.P. Police）成员，另有六名日本士兵睡在主餐厅相邻的一个房间内。（夜间向后者提供了来自单身汉食堂的茶点）。

从1938年5月2日晚上9时开始，两名日本军事哨兵（一人配备步枪）被部署在南京路新雅餐厅外，另有一名工部局警员（S.M.P.）和一名日本军警（J.M.P.）也由路区捕房主管警官指派在该餐厅附近执勤。关于日本哨兵，他们由松散部署的日本士兵每小时轮换一次。

南京路上的勤务由多名华捕（C.M.C.s）加强，他们被安排在规定的间隔距离上，同时一名外籍警长也被指派在新新公司（Sun Sun Company）外及新雅餐厅对面执勤。

除上述人员外，C.A.I. Sharman 还指派了特别巡逻队，由外籍和华人侦探组成，在附近巡逻并保持观察，特别注意过往的日本海陆军车辆。

1938年5月2日上午11时45分，一 detachment 的海福尔德高地团（Seaforth Highlanders）乘坐几辆军用卡车抵达南京路与江西路，并在哨兵按如下方式部署后：

POLICE REPORT.

HAND GRENADE EXPLOSION AT THE CORNER OF
NANKING & KWEICHOW ROADS ON 1: 5:38.
-----------------------

At 5.18 p.m. on 1:5:38, a telephone
message was received from C.P.C. to the effect
that a bomb had been thrown at the corner of
Nanking and Kweichow Roads, and requesting that
the ambulance attend to remove pedestrians who
were injured.

All available police with a C/I. and
C.D.I. immediately proceeded to the scene.

The D.O. "A", D.D.O. "A" and Reserve
Unit were notified and attended.

The S.F.B. Ambulance was summoned and
conveyed from the scene to the Lester Chinese
Hospital the undernoted persons who were suffer-
ing from injuries inflicted by fragments of the
missile.

1. Loh Sing Yue, (陸新猷) age 26,
native of Zaushing, Proprietor of the
Wei Tsang Riesha Hong, 557 Ningpo Road.

"Bomb wound of left chest; very
serious; will require about 10
days' treatment O.P.D."

2. Pang Ah Zung (彭阿成) age 25, native
of Tungchow, M/Private Riesha Coolie,
Hse. No.8, Ts Wei Li, off Seymour Road.

"Bomb wound of right arm; fairly
serious; will require about 5
days' treatment O.P.D."

3. Zung Daung Sa (陳堂史) age 39, native
of Canton, M/female, No.20, Ching Shing Li,
off Tsapeo Road.

1938年5月1日南京路与贵州路转角处手榴弹爆炸案。
---

1938年5月1日下午5时18分，接中央捕房电话称，南京路与贵州路转角处有人投掷炸弹，并要求派遣救护车运送受伤行人。

所有可用警力携刑事调查员（C.I.）及刑事侦缉警员（C.D.I.）立即赶赴现场。

“A”区巡官、“A”区副巡官及后备队均获通知并到场。

召来工部局火政处救护车，将下列因弹片受伤的人员从现场送往莱斯中国医院。

1. 陆新猷（Loh Sing Yue），26岁，浙江乍浦人，宁波路557号伟藏丽纱行店主。

“左胸炸弹伤；伤势严重；需门诊治疗约10天。”

2. 彭阿成（Pang Ah Zung），25岁，江苏通州人，西摩路侧慈卫里8号住户，丽纱行苦力。

“右臂炸弹伤；伤势相当严重；需门诊治疗约5天。”

3. 陈堂史（Zung Daung Sa），39岁，广东人，女，乍浦路侧庆盛里20号住户。

经副督察史密斯（Smith）、副督察麦克伦南（MacLennan）、日籍副督察小林（Kobayashi）、刑事侦缉警员35号、336号及刑事侦缉队长172号调查，情况如下：

1938年5月1日下午5时15分左右，一枚手榴弹在南京路爆炸，地点位于南侧路缘石以南约10英尺、贵州路以东约12英尺处，即南京路727号“梅西”公司食品店门外，正对先施公司百货商店西北角。

pages.en:
- 3 -

store, 727 Nanking Road, and opposite the North
West corner of the Sun Sun Coy. Department Store.

At that time the C.P.C. was on traffic
duty at the South corner of Nanking/Weichow Roads
whilst an S.P.C. was on traffic duty at the oppos-
ite corner of the said roads. The said S.P.C.
sustained an injury as already explained and came
to the Station, whilst C.P.C., on noticing the
injured pedestrians, telephoned details to this
Station.

A search at the scene resulted in 21
splinters being found, also 8 pieces of glass
about ¼" thick, and several pieces of what appears
to be a green stocking or sock being found.

From the splinters it appears that the
hand-grenade was of the green painted segment
military type with a screw top about one inch in
diameter; (believed to be similar to the two
grenades which were thrown in Central District
on 30:4:38 and referred to in Central Misc. 464/38).
The top bears the number "26" and the Chinese
characters " " - "Latest Model". The
grenade had apparently been wrapped in the green
stocking or sock referred to when thrown. The
glass had apparently been included but it is not
known for what purpose.

A Ford Sedan Motor Car, S.M.C. Lic.No.
5034, owned by one named Sang Zen Yee, c/o Messrs.
Butterfield & Swire, was parked on the South side
of Nanking Road near to where the grenade exploded,
and suffered from a deflated tyre as a result of—
pages.zh:
- 3 -

当时，中央捕房的一名华捕正在南京路/贵州路南侧路口执行交通勤务，而一名锡克警察则在上述道路的对角路口执行交通勤务。该锡克警察如前所述受伤并来到捕房，而该华捕发现受伤行人后，电话向本捕房报告了详情。

在现场搜查中，发现了21块碎片，以及8块约1/4英寸厚的玻璃片，还有几块看似绿色长袜或短袜的织物。

从碎片来看，该手榴弹为绿色涂漆的分段式军用型，顶部有螺丝盖，直径约一英寸；（据信与1938年4月30日在中央区投掷的两枚手榴弹相似，参见中区杂项档案464/38）。顶部标有数字“26”及汉字“ ”——“最新式”。手榴弹在投掷时显然包裹在上述绿色长袜或短袜中。玻璃片显然也被包含在内，但其用途不明。

一辆福特轿车，工部局牌照号5034，车主为桑振义（Sang Zen Yee，音译），通讯处为太古洋行（Butterfield & Swire），停放在南京路南侧靠近手榴弹爆炸处，因一枚小手榴弹碎片穿透而导致轮胎漏气。

a small splinter of the grenade having penetrated.
No further damage to this motor car or any other
property was observed.

Mr. S.C. Young, D.C. (Crime), who was
present at the scene on arrival of detectives,
stated that at about 5.15 p.m. whilst he was pro-
ceeding East in his motor car on Nanking Road he,
when in the vicinity of Yu Ya Ching Road, noticed
a Japanese Naval M/Truck proceeding in the same
direction about 100 yards ahead and that this
M/Truck had been passing the scene when the ex-
plosion occurred. Mr. Young added that, due to
the distance, he did not witness the grenade being
thrown, but thought that the truck carried the
Japanese Naval Landing Party No.117 and that two
Japanese Marines were standing at the front on
either side of same.

The Deputy Governor of the Ward Road Gaol
who was also present at the scene, stated that whilst
he was walking East on the North pavement of Nanking
Road, he heard the explosion and looked round to
observe a Japanese M/Truck, number unknown, appear
to accelerate in an Easterly direction on Nanking
Road from the scene. Due to having been walking
East, however, and several yards from the scene, he
did not witness the grenade being thrown.

Mr. G.L. Aitchison, attached to the S.M.C.
High Chih Kuei School, No.20 B, Lane 1112, Yu Yuen Road,
supplied information to the effect that at about 5.15 p.m.
he was proceeding East on Nanking Road in his motor
car when the explosion occurred about 40 yards ahead
of him. He then noticed a Japanese Naval truck,
pages.zh:
- 4 -

未发现该汽车或其他财产遭受进一步损坏。

刑事处副处长杨先生（Mr. S.C. Young）在侦探到达现场时已在场，他表示，下午5时15分左右，当他驾车沿南京路向东行驶至虞洽卿路附近时，注意到前方约100码处有一辆日本海军卡车同向行驶，且爆炸发生时该卡车正经过现场。杨先生补充说，由于距离较远，他未目睹手榴弹被投掷的过程，但认为该卡车载有日本海军第117登陆队，且有两名日本海军陆战队员站在车头两侧。

华德路监狱副典狱长也在现场，他表示，当他在南京路北侧人行道向东行走时，听到爆炸声，回头看到一辆编号不明的日本军用卡车似乎从现场加速向东驶去。然而，由于他当时正向东行走且距离现场数码之遥，并未目睹手榴弹被投掷。

附属于工部局高职学校（High Chih Kuei School）的 G.L. Aitchison 先生，住址为愚园路1112弄20号B室，提供信息称，下午5时15分左右，他正驾车沿南京路向东行驶，爆炸发生在他前方约40码处。随后他注意到一辆日本海军卡车，

pages.en:
- 5 -

on which there were two men in blue uniform standing,
some 30 yards ahead of where the explosion occurred.
The truck continued without stop; in and the men on
same apparently paid no attention to the incident.

An .. .C. when later questioned, stated
that he did not witness the grenade being thrown as
at that time he had been facing west on Nanking Road.
He however, noticed the Japanese Naval truck pass
at about the time the explosion occurred.

The C.P.C. likewise did not witness the
grenade being thrown and states that he did not
notice the Japanese truck.

The ten injured Chinese pedestrians were
questioned but all denied having witnessed the
grenade being thrown and could not or declined to
offer additional information or assistance.

Further extensive enquiries were made at
the scene but no person volunteered information as
to having witnessed the grenade being thrown.

It was ascertained from the American
Military patrols at the corner of Nanking/Yu Ya
Ching Roads that at about 5.15 p.m. 1:5:38, a
Japanese Naval M/truck bearing the Japanese Land-
ing Party Number 117, proceeded East on Nanking
Road past that corner and carried four Japanese
Marines, two of whom were standing in the truck.

At 7 p.m. 1:5:38 a telephone message was
received from an S/I. on duty in Hongkew Charge Room,
to the effect that at 5.30 p.m. 1:5:38 a J.P.C. while
on duty at the Garden Bridge was informed by 3 Japanese
Marines who were in the Naval M/truck that at about
5.15 p.m. a hand-grenade had been thrown at the said
pages.zh:
- 5 -

车上有两名身穿蓝色制服的人站立，位于爆炸点前方约30码处。卡车未停车继续行驶；车上人员显然未对该事件予以关注。

一名……（原文不清）后来接受询问时表示，由于当时他在南京路上面向西方，故未目睹手榴弹被投掷。但他注意到日本海军卡车在爆炸发生的大致时间经过。

中央捕房的华捕同样未目睹手榴弹被投掷，并称未注意到日本卡车。

十名受伤的华人行人接受了询问，但均否认目睹手榴弹被投掷，且无法或拒绝提供额外信息或协助。

在现场进行了进一步的广泛调查，但无人自愿提供关于目睹手榴弹被投掷的信息。

经向南京路/虞洽卿路路口的美军巡逻队核实，1938年5月1日下午5时15分左右，一辆载有四名日本海军陆战队员（其中两人站立在车内）的日本海军卡车，标有日本登陆队第117号，沿南京路向东驶过该路口。

1938年5月1日晚7时，接虹口捕房值班印捕电话称，下午5时30分，一名日捕在外白渡桥执勤时，获悉三名在日本海军卡车内的日本海军陆战队员告知，下午5时15分左右，一枚手榴弹被投掷向该

pages.en:
- 6 -
truck whilst proceeding East on Nanking Road near Kwe chow Road.
At 8.40 p.m. 1-5-38, two Japanese motor trucks with
some thirty armed Japanese soldiers arrived at the scene and
formed a line on the South side of Nanking Road between
Kwangse and Yunnan Roads. Traffic, however, was not obstructed.
Reserve Unit and the Station Search Parties combed all
roads and alleyways in this district but to no avail. Premises
in the vicinity of the scene including the Sun Sun Roof Garden
and Hotel were searched on four different occasions, the last
in conjunction with the Japanese Gendarmerie but nothing of an
incriminating nature was found and no arrests made. A male
named Yang Sung Foo ( 楊仁甫 ), age 24, native of Soochow,
Shop-assistant, residing at House No. 25, Lane 337, Avenue
Joffre, F.C., was observed to walk away quickly on Nanking Road
from the said Hotel premises and was stopped by members of the
Japanese Military Intelligence who, being satisfied with his
replies, allowed him to go.
Finally, as a result of a conference held in the Sun Ya
Restaurant at which Mr. Gilbert Officer i/c Divisions, Japanese
Consul General Okazaki, Colonel Kekuchi, Major Yokoto and Mr.
Uyehara D.C.(Japanese) were present, the Japanese troops were
withdrawn from the scene at 10.55 p.m. 1-5-38 with the exception
of three Japanese soldiers, 3 Japanese civilians and 3 Japanese
members of the S.M.P. who remained in the Sun Ya Restaurant.
Six Japanese soldiers and 1 N.C.O. were permitted to remain
in this Station for one night only according to arrangements
made with Major Yokote and Officer i/c Divisions.
Lieutenant Fukuyama, attached to the Japanese Special
Landing Party Headquarters and a party of Japanese Military
Police under Corp. Hasegawa (Plain clothes) attended at this
station and examined the grenade fragments.
Major Yokota, Chief of Japanese Military Police, Settlement
Detachment and Warrant Officer Shimowatari, i/c of Bridge House
Japanese Military Police, were in charge of the detachment which
pages.zh:
- 6 -
卡车，当时该车正沿南京路向东行驶至贵州路附近。
1938年5月1日晚8时40分，两辆日本军用卡车搭载约三十名武装日本士兵抵达现场，在南京路广西路与云南路之间的南侧排成一列。然而，交通并未受阻。
后备队及各捕房搜查组对该区域的所有道路和巷弄进行了梳篦式搜查，但一无所获。包括先施屋顶花园及酒店在内的现场周边处所先后四次受到搜查，最后一次是与日本宪兵队联合进行，但未发现任何罪证，也未实施逮捕。一名名为杨仁甫（Yang Sung Foo）的男子，24岁，苏州人，店员，居住在法租界霞飞路337弄25号，被观察到从上述酒店处所快速沿南京路离开，并被日本军事情报人员拦下，后者对其回答表示满意后予以放行。
最后，经在新亚酒店举行会议，出席者有分区主管吉尔伯特·奥菲瑟先生（Mr. Gilbert Officer）、日本总领事冈崎（Okazaki）、菊池大佐（Colonel Kekuchi）、横田少校（Major Yokoto）及日籍副处长上原先生（Mr. Uyehara），日军于1938年5月1日晚10时55分撤离现场，仅留三名日本士兵、三名日本平民及三名工部局警务处的日籍人员驻守新亚酒店。根据与横田少校及分区主管达成的安排，六名日本士兵和一名士官获准在本捕房留宿一晚。
隶属于日本特别登陆队总部的福山中尉（Lieutenant Fukuyama）及由长谷曹长（Corp. Hasegawa，便衣）率领的一队日本宪兵来到本捕房，检查了手榴弹碎片。
日本宪兵队租界分队长横田少校（Major Yokota）及桥宅日本宪兵负责人下渡准尉（Warrant Officer Shimowatari）负责指挥前往

1938年5月1日下午5时18分，接到第3369号巡长电话报告，称有人向南京路与贵州路转角处投掷炸弹，并要求派遣救护车救治受伤行人。

store, 727 Nanking Road, and opposite the North West Corner

At that time, P.C. 3369 was on Traffic duty at the
South corner of Nanking-Chekiang roads whilst P.C. 682 was
on traffic duty at the opposite corner of the said roads. The
said P.C. sustained an injury as already explained and came
to this Station, whilst P.C. 3369, a policeman, the injured
pedestrians, telephoned details to this Station.

A search of the scene resulted in 4 splinters of the
grenade being found, also a piece of glass, about 1/8 of an
inch thick, and several pieces of what appears to be a green
cotton stocking or sock were found.

From the splinters it appears that the hand-grenade
was of the green painted segment military type with a screw
top about 1 1/2 ins. diameter. Believed to be similar to the
two grenades which were thrown in Central District on 30-4-38
and referred to in Central Misc. 464/38). The top, bears the
number "2C" and the Chinese characters "二二式" "Latest
Model". The grenade had apparently been wrapped in the green
stocking or sock, referred to, when thrown. The glass had
apparently been included but it is not known for what purpose.

A "Ford" Sedan Motor Car, S.M.C. Lic. No. 5034, owned
by one named Zeng Zeu Yue, c/o Messrs Butterfield & Swire,
was ranked on the South side of Nanking Road near to where
the grenade exploded, and suffered from a deflated tyre as
a result of a small splinter of the grenade having penetrated.
No further damage to this motor car or any other property
was observed.

1938年5月1日下午5时15分左右，一枚手榴弹在南京路爆炸，位置距南侧路缘石约10英尺，贵州路以东约12英尺，位于南京路727号“Rosy”公司食品店门外，正对先施公司百货商店的西北角。

当时，第3369号巡警正在南京路与浙江路南路角的交通岗执勤，而第682号巡警则在该路口对面的角落执行交通任务。如上所述，该巡警受伤后来到本捕房，而第3369号巡警、一名警察及受伤行人则通过电话向本捕房报告了详情。

对现场的搜查发现了4块手榴弹碎片，还有一块约1/8英寸厚的玻璃片，以及几块看似绿色棉质长袜或短袜的碎片。

从碎片来看，该手榴弹为绿色涂装的分段式军用类型，顶部有螺纹，直径约1.5英寸。据信与1938年4月30日在中央区投掷的两枚手榴弹相似（参见中央区杂项档案 464/38）。顶部标有数字“2C”及汉字“二二式”“最新式”。手榴弹在投掷时显然被包裹在上述绿色袜子中。玻璃片显然也被包含在内，但其用途不明。

一辆福特（Ford）轿车，工部局车牌号5034，车主为曾祖悦（Zeng Zeu Yue，音译），通讯处为太古洋行（Messrs Butterfield & Swire），当时停靠在南京路南侧靠近手榴弹爆炸处，因一小块手榴弹碎片刺入导致轮胎漏气。未发现该汽车或其他财产遭受进一步损坏。

occurred. The truck continued without stopping and the men on
same apparently paid no attention to the incident.

pages.en:
Japanese Post Sentries After
Nanking Road Bombing

Ten Chinese and One Indian Wounded as Terrorist
Explodes Missile and Escapes in Crowd

A MILITARY hand-grenade was thrown by an unidentified person in Nanking Road, at Kweichow Road, at 5.16 o'clock yesterday afternoon, injuring ten Chinese and an Indian policeman and striking terror into the hearts of hundreds of persons in the neighbourhood. More than an hour afterwards, two truckloads of Japanese Military Police arrived on the scene and sentries were posted on both sides of Nanking Road, from Kwangse Road to Yunnan Road. They were not withdrawn until about 11 o'clock.

The bomb, which was of the Mills type and of like manufacture to the two hand-grenades thrown on The Bund on Saturday morning, exploded at a time when a Japanese naval lorry was passing, although on the opposite side of the street. No-one in the lorry was injured, nor was any damage done to the vehicle.

A tense situation was created by the display of Japanese fighting power in the populous neighbourhood, and the tension was not eased until the sentries were finally withdrawn from Nanking Road at about 11 p.m. The soldiers arrived in a truck with a machine-gun mounted over the driver's seat, and another lorry. They were posted at short distances from each other in Nanking Road and on the side-streets south of that thoroughfare. All had bayonets fixed to their rifles. They started searching Chinese pedestrians coming along Nanking Road from both directions and kept up searching for a considerable time. Officers of the Military Police meanwhile remained on the south side of Nanking Road, outside Sun Ya's Restaurant and in front of Chinese shops between Sun Ya's and Kweichow Road.

The Municipal Police were on the scene immediately after the bombing and conducted three independent searches of alleyways and Chinese hotels and other buildings between Chekiang Road and Yunnan Road, and a fourth search accompanied by members of the Japanese Consular Police. Although several persons were interrogated at Sun Sun's Hotel and elsewhere, no-one had been arrested up to a late hour. The Police Reserve Unit, whose "red marias" speeded to Nanking Road as soon as the explosion had occurred, threw a cordon about the district. The vans remained on the scene till a late hour and members of the Reserve Unit kept the surging Chinese crowds back on all streets.

Independent investigations were carried out by the British Military Headquarters and officers of the Fourth United States Marines, who conferred with the Japanese officers present. Members of the American Marine Corps also kept a close eye on the situation at the corner of Bubbling Well and Yu Ya Ching Roads, where, after last January's Japanese "Victory Parade," Japanese soldiers penetrated the American defence sector.

High Officials Called

A number of high police officials visited the scene in the course of the evening, including Maj. K. M. Bourne, Deputy Commissioner; Mr. S. Uyehara, Deputy Commissioner; Messrs. G. W. Gilbert, W. E. Fairbairn and E. D. M. Robertson, Assistant Commissioners; Supt. A. H. Aiers; Supt. Yao; and Chief Insp. R. Shells-well, in charge of Louza Police District. Mr. Fairbairn had charge of the Reserve Unit personnel, with Chief Insp. J. F. Lovell leading of the vans. The Japanese officials present included Maj. Masataka Yokota, of the Gendarmerie, and various high naval and consular officers.

The bomb exploded on the pavement near the south footpath, opposite 727 Nanking Road. There was a loud detonation as fragments of steel were scattered about. Ten Chinese were injured, two of them seriously, and were taken in ambulances to the Lester Hospital. Besides, the Sikh traffic policeman on point duty at Kweichow Road was slightly wounded and was sent to the Police Hospital. A private motor-car parked at the south kerb was damaged by pieces of steel.

The Reserve Unit had already completed its preliminary search of the neighbourhood, and Nanking Road had resumed a normal aspect, with traffic moving briskly, when the Japanese military arrived. Traffic was immediately affected by the posting of sentries in the street, while on the footpaths the searching of pedestrians added to the traffic problem. For awhile the only non-Japanese who could inspect the immediate scene of the bombing were the foreign police officers conducting the investigation.

Restaurant Guests Watch

At Sun Ya's interested diners watched the scene from first and second storey windows, while a huge crowd of curious Chinese gathered at Chekiang Road crossing to look at the proceedings from a distance. Japanese photographers were permitted by the Japanese military to take flashlight pictures, and a succession of bright blazes marked their work. Groups of the Japanese officials posed for special views.

Early this morning the negotiations about the case were continued at Louza Police Station, where high foreign officials of the S.M.P. conferred with the Japanese officers. No arrest had been made up to midnight.

（批：8 3/5 R 2/5）

南京路爆炸案后的日军哨兵

恐怖分子在人群中引爆投掷物后逃脱，十名华人和一名印籍巡捕受伤

昨日下午5时16分，一名身份不明者在南京路与贵州路路口投掷了一枚军用手榴弹，致使十名华人和一名印籍巡捕受伤，并令附近数百人惊恐万分。一个多小时后，两卡车日本宪兵抵达现场，并在南京路从广西路至云南路路段的两侧部署了哨兵。直至约11时，哨兵才撤离。

这枚炸弹属于米尔斯型（Mills type），其制造样式与周六早晨在外滩投掷的两枚手榴弹相同。爆炸发生时，一辆日本海军卡车正经过该处，尽管位于街道的另一侧。卡车内无人受伤，车辆也未受损。

日军在这一人口稠密地区展示武力，造成了紧张局势，直到晚上约11时哨兵最终从南京路撤离，紧张气氛才得以缓解。士兵们乘坐一辆在驾驶座上方装有机关枪的卡车和另一辆卡车抵达。他们在南京路及该主干道以南的支路上，每隔短距离便部署一人。所有人的步枪都装上了刺刀。他们开始搜查从两个方向沿南京路走来的中国行人，并持续搜查了相当长的一段时间。与此同时，宪兵军官留在南京路南侧，位于孙亚饭店（Sun Ya's Restaurant）外以及孙亚饭店与贵州路之间的中国商店门前。

爆炸发生后，工部局警务处人员立即赶到现场，并对浙江路与云南路之间的小巷、华人旅馆及其他建筑物进行了三次独立搜查，第四次搜查则由日本领事馆警察陪同进行。虽然在孙孙旅馆（Sun Sun's Hotel）及其他地方讯问了数人，但直至深夜并未逮捕任何人。警务处后备队（Police Reserve Unit）的“红色玛丽亚”（red marias，指警车）在爆炸发生后迅速驶往南京路，对该区域实施了封锁。警车在现场停留至深夜，后备队成员在所有街道上阻挡涌动的人群。

英军司令部和美国海军陆战队第四团的军官也进行了独立调查，并与在场的日本军官进行了磋商。美国海军陆战队队员还密切监视着静安寺路与虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Roads）拐角处的局势，在去年一月日本举行“胜利游行”后，日本士兵曾渗入美军防区。

高官到场

当晚，多名警务高层官员视察了现场，包括副总监 K. M. Bourne 少校；副总监 S. Uyehara 先生；助理总监 G. W. Gilbert、W. E. Fairbairn 和 E. D. M. Robertson 先生；警司 A. H. Aiers；姚警司（Supt. Yao）；以及负责老闸捕房辖区的总督察 R. Shells-well。Fairbairn 先生负责指挥后备队人员，总督察 J. F. Lovell 率领警车车队。到场的日本官员包括宪兵队横田正隆（Masataka Yokota）少校，以及多位海军和领事馆高级官员。

炸弹在南京路727号对面的人行道南侧路边爆炸。随着钢片四散，发出巨大的爆炸声。十名华人受伤，其中两人伤势严重，由救护车送往仁济医院（Lester Hospital）。此外，在贵州路口执勤的锡克族交通巡捕受轻伤，被送往警务处医院。一辆停在南侧路缘的私人汽车被钢片损坏。

当日军抵达时，后备队已完成对该地区的初步搜查，南京路已恢复正常面貌，交通流动顺畅。哨兵在街道上的部署立即影响了交通，而人行道上对行人的搜查则加剧了交通问题。有一段时间，唯一能勘察爆炸核心现场的非日籍人士是正在进行调查的外籍警务官员。

餐馆食客围观

在孙亚饭店，感兴趣的食客从一楼和二楼的窗户观看现场，而一大群好奇的中国民众聚集在浙江路路口，从远处观望事态发展。日本军方允许日本摄影师拍摄闪光灯照片，一连串明亮的闪光标志着他们的工作。一群日本官员摆姿势拍摄特写照片。

今天清晨，有关此案的谈判在老闸捕房继续进行，工部局警务处的高级外籍官员与日本军官进行了会晤。截至午夜，尚未有人被捕。

（批：8 3/5 R 2/5）

Japanese Shoot
Shell - Thrower

Chinese Meets Death
For Attempt Made
Against Navy

Chang Chin-hsiang, 28 years old, who on April 21 tossed a trench-mortar shell at a Japanese naval car on the Bund, was executed by the Japanese authorities yesterday, a Japanese report stated today.

The man was arrested by a Sikh watchman of the Yokohama Specie Bank, after he threw the shell at an automobile carrying four Japanese naval officers.

Failed To Explode

With the safety-pin undrawn, the shell did not explode. Immediately after the incident, Chang was taken over by Japanese gendarmes and subjected to an examination by naval officials. The sentence of death followed the man's conviction on charges of attempting to do harm to officers of the Japanese Navy.

Was Anti-Japanese

Chang was said by the report to have confessed that he harbored anti-Japanese sentiments long before the outbreak of the current hostilities.

Employed at the Chu Feng Works, the man lost his job when fighting began in Shanghai. He then returned to his native place in Tsungming.

On April 15, the man returned here in search of work. For four days, he walked the streets, but found no employment.

Sought Job

On April 19, he met Hsu Ken, an old friend, and asked him for a job. Hsu promised assistance and told Chang to lodge that night at a doss-house on Canton Road.

He also gave Chang a dollar for his expenses.

The following morning, Hsu visited Chang at the lodging-house and told him that his efforts to find employment for Chang were unsuccessful.

As a measure of consolation, Hsu asked Chang to meet him the following morning in front of the Great Shanghai Hotel, Chekiang Road.

Job Suggested

At 8 o'clock on the fateful morning, Chang was on spot, waiting anxiously for his friend. When Hsu appeared, he pulled Chang to a lane nearby and proposed that the unemployed youth should throw a "grenade" at Japanese.

If Chang carried out his assignment, Hsu promised to assist him in the future, the report continued.

As a further incentive, Hsu proffered Chang a five-dollar bill. Desperate because of his vain quest of work and none-too-friendly towards the Japanese, Chang readily agreed to "do the job," the report said.

Hsu then pulled out the shell from his gown and showed Chang how to pull out the safety pin. The two men, then, proceeded down Peking Road, towards the Bund.

Throws Shell

Chang posted himself close to the Yokohama Specie Bank and began a vigil for his quarry. At 11:40 o'clock in the morning, he finally saw a Japanese naval car nearby.

Hastily, the man stepped up and hurled the shell at the automobile. In his eagerness, however, he forgot to pull out the safety pin.

The Sikh watchman, who had his eye on the man for some time immediately pounced on the youth and apprehended him. A few minutes later, he was taken to the Hongkew district by Japanese gendarmes.

日军枪决
投掷炮弹者

华人因企图
袭击海军
而被处决

据今日一份日本报告称，现年28岁的张金祥（Chang Chin-hsiang，音译）于4月21日在外滩向一辆日本海军汽车投掷迫击炮弹，昨日被日本当局处决。

该男子在向载有四名日本海军军官的汽车投掷炮弹后，被横滨正金银行的一名锡克族看守逮捕。

未能爆炸

由于未拔出保险销，炮弹没有爆炸。事件发生后，张随即被日本宪兵接管，并接受海军官员的审讯。该男子因企图伤害日本海军军官罪名成立，随后被判处死刑。

系反日分子

据报道，张承认早在当前敌对行动爆发之前，他就怀有反日情绪。

张受雇于楚丰工厂（Chu Feng Works，音译），上海战事开始后他失去了工作。随后他返回崇明老家。

4月15日，该男子回到上海寻找工作。他在街头奔波了四天，但未找到工作。

求职

4月19日，他遇到了老朋友徐肯（Hsu Ken，音译），并向其求职。徐答应帮忙，并让张当晚住在广东路的一家廉价客栈里。

他还给了张一块钱作为路费。

第二天早上，徐到客栈看望张，告诉他为张找工作的努力未能成功。

为了安慰张，徐让张第二天早上在浙江路的大上海大酒店前与他见面。

提议作案

在那个命运攸关的早晨8点，张到达现场，焦急地等待朋友。当徐出现时，他把张拉到附近的一条弄堂里，提议这名失业青年向日本人投掷一枚“手榴弹”。

报告继续称，如果张完成任务，徐承诺将来会帮助他。

作为进一步的诱饵，徐递给张一张五美元钞票。报告称，由于求职无望且对日本人不太友好，张处于绝望之中， readily 同意了“做这笔生意”。

随后，徐从长袍中掏出炮弹，并向张展示了如何拔出保险销。然后，两人沿着北京路向外滩走去。

投掷炮弹

张在横滨正金银行附近埋伏，开始守候目标。上午11时40分，他终于看到附近有一辆日本海军汽车。

该男子急忙上前，向汽车投掷炮弹。然而，由于急切，他忘记拔出保险销。

一直盯着该男子的锡克族看守立即扑向这名青年并将其逮捕。几分钟后，他被日本宪兵带往虹口区。

at House No.2C Lane 1112 Yu Yuen Rd., who had been in

Mrs. Kershaw stated that at about 9.45a.m. on the

Bund accompanied by her daughter, when as she was passing
the Yokohama Specie Bank, a black object was thrown and
fell down on the roadway a short distance from where
she was at that time. She looked and saw that the object
was apparently a bomb. A male Chinese who was standing
at the mouth of a small alleyway was then arrested by an
Indian and held outside the bank premises, whilst a
Japanese constable picked up the bomb and carried same
into the bank. The person arrested was then escorted into
the bank premises.

Mrs. Kershaw did not see the motorcar in which

Reference Throwing of a Hand-Grenade
by a Male Chinese outside
The Yokohama Specie Bank, The Bund.

Sir,

At 10.00 a.m. 21-4-38, a report was made to this Station by J.P.C.41 by telephone requesting services of detectives as a bomb had been thrown outside the Yokohama Specie Bank, No.24, The Bund.

D.S.I. Taylor, D.S. Kobayashi, and S.I. Okawa immediately attended and ascertained the following facts:-

At approximately 9.45 a.m. 21-4-38, S.P.W.380, Gurdbaksh Singh, employed on day duty outside the premises of the Yokohama Specie Bank, No.24 The Bund, was standing at the corner of an unnumbered alleyway and the banks premises, when he saw a male Chinese, (who was standing about 5 yards South of the S.P.W.) throw with his right hand, a hand-grenade, at a party of petty officers of the H.I.J.M.S. "Idzumo", who, in a private motor car, were turning North on the Bund from the above mentioned alleyway. (These officers had visited the bank, entering and leaving by a side entrance in the alleyway). The hand-grenade struck the rear top of the motor car and bounced to the roof from where it rolled off the side of the car striking the ground.

先生，

1938年4月21日上午10时，J.P.C.41通过电话向本站报告，请求派遣侦探，因为有一颗炸弹被投掷在外滩24号横滨正金银行外。

泰勒（Taylor）侦探副督察、小林（Kobayashi）侦探警长和大川（Okawa）巡佐立即赶赴现场，并查明了以下事实：-

1938年4月21日上午9时45分左右，S.P.W.380号古尔巴克什·辛格（Gurdbaksh Singh）正在外滩24号横滨正金银行 premises 外执行白班勤务，他站在一条无门牌号的弄堂口与银行 premises 的角落处，此时他看到一名中国男子（站在距S.P.W.以南约5码处）用右手向一群日本海军“出云”号（H.I.J.M.S. "Idzumo"）的士官投掷了一枚手榴弹，这些士官正乘坐一辆私人汽车从上述弄堂驶出，在外滩向北转弯。（这些军官曾访问银行，通过弄堂内的侧门进出）。手榴弹击中了汽车的后顶部，弹到车顶上，然后从车侧滚落至地面。

Major L. Miyazaki of the Military Police accompanied
by three Naval Officers visited the scene and informed
D.S. Kobayashi to the effect that the hand-grenade
in question was of Japanese War manufacture, and refused
to allow same to be photographed owing to the fact that
this hand-grenade was a very recent product and he had
instructions to prevent same from becoming publicly
known. He added that a sketch-map or photograph of
this grenade would be made by the Japanese authorities
and a copy later supplied to the S.M.Police.

The grenade was taken to Bridge Branch Headquarters
by D.S. Kobayashi accompanied by the D.O."A"., and same
was shown to the Commissioner of Police, D.C.(Divisions),
and A.C.(A.I.C...); (not seen by the D.C."Crime", owing
to his absence at the time).

It was known that the Japanese Military Police
required the return of the grenade, stating that same
was Military Property, and, as no objections were raised,
it was handed over to Sergeant Major Shibuya of the
Military Police by D.S. Kobayashi after examination by
the Finger Print Bureau (D.S.I.Dickson). D.S. Kobayashi
accompanied by the undersigned proceeded to Bridge
House where Sergeant Major Shibuya gave the following
facts in the presence of the accused.
pages.zh:
第3页。

宪兵少佐宫崎（L. Miyazaki，音译）在三名海军军官的陪同下视察了现场，并告知警探小林（D.S. Kobayashi），称涉案手榴弹为日本战时制造产品，并以该手榴弹系最新产品、奉命防止其公开为由，拒绝允许对其进行拍照。他补充说，日本当局将绘制该手榴弹的示意图或拍摄照片，随后向上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.Police）提供副本。

该手榴弹由警探小林在“A”区值班警官（D.O."A".）的陪同下带至虹口捕房总部，并向警务总监、分区副总监（D.C.(Divisions)）及助理总监（A.C.(A.I.C...)）出示；（因犯罪组副总监（D.C."Crime"）当时不在，故未向其出示）。

据悉，日本宪兵队要求归还该手榴弹，称其为军用财产。由于无人提出异议，经指纹局（由警探迪克森 D.S.I. Dickson 负责）检验后，警探小林将该手榴弹移交给宪兵队军曹长涩谷（Shibuya，音译）。警探小林与具名人一同前往横滨大楼（Bridge House），被告在场，军曹长涩谷陈述了以下事实。

如本报告前文所述，被告被逮捕并带入银行内，一名海军军官（涉案汽车内的乘客之一）立即致电日本军事情报机构，致使日本军事情报机构（J.M.I.）代表迅速赶到，在警方到达之前即将此人带走进行紧急问询。事后军曹长涩谷解释说，鉴于该案性质重要，且可能涉及日本臣民，加之该手榴弹系近期配发给日军的新式产品（属需严格保密的新产品），不应在上海轻易获得，因此此类特定物品在此出现构成了军方极为重视的事项，故需立即进行问询，以免不必要地……

截至本报告撰写时，未能获取涉案汽车内日本海军乘客的姓名，但稍后将予以获取。

（签名）
警探 sergeant 1/6。

（签名：Dayle）
